Method of Attack: Malicious phishing email attachments that drop IcedID banking trojan payload
Use of Cobalt Strike for lateral movement throughout victims' networks
Use of credential dumping tools (SharpKatz, BetterSafetyKatz, Mimikatz) for credential access
Use of Rclone for data exfiltration
Encryption of files with random eight-character extension and ransom note with .onion website link
Threat actors contact victims via telephone and email threatening data release unless ransom paid in virtual currency
Impacted Systems: Victims' networks and systems infected with IcedID and ransomware
Indicators of Compromise: Victim ransom notes linking to .onion website
